title: `concepts/self-blindness` omits the self/other parity family that SEP "Introspection" (2024) classifies as entailing self-blindness ("accounts according to which one is self-blind in Shoemaker's sense"), defended for attitudes by Carruthers (2011); `concepts/phenomenal-transparency-opacity-spectrum` L77 overstates Carruthers's parity as covering all mental states (SEP: attitudes only)
